input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 binds the Company (our client) to exclusive dealing: it may not participate in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI holds the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand online. The restriction runs "during the term of this Agreement," and Section 4.1 makes the term automatically renew for successive one-year periods indefinitely unless terminated on 90 days' notice, with Section 4.2 imposing a Termination Payment if the Company terminates. There is no service-level regime and no termination-for-breach right; the only performance-based exit (Section 1.6) is a one-off right if the Site is not operational within 70 days of signature, which lapses at launch. The result is exclusive dealing for the full (potentially perpetual) term with no ongoing performance-based exit — walk-away territory under this rule, and short of the fallback's 12-month cap and automatic release on failure to meet service levels or delivery dates. Because HDI grants a reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 (which benefits us and we leave intact), deleting the exclusivity outright would be disproportionate, so we redline to the fallback: a 12-month cap plus automatic termination of the restriction on any HDI delivery or performance failure. The product scope is tied to the defined term "Deerskin Products" and is acceptable; we note but do not separately flag the open-ended "companies similar to" wording.

proposal.summary: Limit the Company's exclusivity in Section 6.1 to 12 months and add an automatic performance-based exit.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.1 locks us out of any similar Deerskin internet project for the whole term, which auto-renews annually and can only be exited on 90 days' notice with a Termination Payment, and there is no release if HDI underperforms. Our playbook does not accept exclusivity on the customer for the full term without a performance exit, so we have capped the restriction at twelve months and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses a delivery date or service level. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 is unchanged.
